title: Origins: Master Of Two
description: Datapack addon for Origins Legacy: Classes that allows you to pick 2 classes at once.
body:
# The Jack of Double Trades
Why settle for one path when you can master two? This datapack expands your character's potential by adding a second "Class" layer. Whether you want to be a Farmer-Cook for the ultimate food supply or a Warrior-Archer for total combat dominance, the choice is now yours.

- How to Use:Install Origins Legacy: Classes (required).
- Add this datapack to your world.
- Upon joining, you will be prompted to pick your Origin, followed by two consecutive Class selection screens.
